pages.text: Entity wagons collide with Sable structures. Boarding clearance and seated-passenger passage checks also consider external physical structures. Wagons retain their own movement and collision system; they do not become Sable structures.

Block-form jacks and wagon parts $(bold)cannot be physicalized$(reset). Physicalizing any component cell recovers that whole part without duplicate drops. A box or jack also releases attached parts and cargo.$(br2)Placing such blocks on a physical structure immediately breaks and drops them. Use entity wagons instead of embedding a jack in a structure.
